Use case: ui-mockup. One finished 16:9 main menu concept for a painterly 2D first-person cocktail tavern story game, title exactly "致未归的客人". Version A: arriving at an island at sunset. An exquisite quiet sunset over a gently rolling teal sea, amber and dusty rose sky fading to lavender, a low small island on the RIGHT with a few timber harbor houses, a modest beacon and one warmly lit tavern window. Foreground a weathered wooden jetty enters from bottom right, coiled rope and one small warm brass lantern. Sea takes generous space, sunlight breaks into small subtle wave reflections. No characters, no tall fantasy castle, no tropical resort, no photorealism, no pixel art, no glossy 3D. Refined hand-painted gouache and digital illustration matching a warm wood-and-brass western harbor tavern game. Delicate brushwork, clear atmospheric depth, beautiful restrained poetry and slight wistfulness, not gloomy.
UI integrated in calm LEFT third: large elegant warm ivory Chinese title "致未归的客人", small spaced subtitle "GUESTS YET TO RETURN", then generous spacing, vertical menu in small ivory serif Chinese "开始游戏", "设置", "制作名单", "退出游戏". Only the first menu entry has a thin understated brass underline and small diamond, no large opaque panels, no mobile game icons. Tiny bottom-right text "海风与潮声". Leave scene unobstructed; strong legibility. Render a single complete polished menu screenshot, no device frame, no concept board, no extra labels. Sunset horizon is around middle, main island on right leaving title readable. This is a first-launch view; do not show an enabled Continue button.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one complete 16:9 polished main-menu screenshot for a hand-painted harbor tavern narrative game, title exactly "致未归的客人". Version B, the empty chair waiting at the tavern: eye-level from a timber tavern veranda looking out over a small island harbor at beautiful sunset. On the LEFT foreground an empty wooden chair angled gently towards the sea, small round wooden table with an unopened envelope, one subdued warm brass lantern, framed by the tavern's dark warm wooden doorway and porch beams. Beyond: rippling jade and blue sea, small island and modest lighthouse on distant center horizon, salmon pink clouds and golden sunset, one very small moored sailboat. Enough open sky and quiet sea on the RIGHT half to read the title and menu. No humans. The feeling is welcome, home, someone missing, hopeful wistfulness rather than grief. Rich but restrained warm hand-painted gouache / digital illustration, detailed light with clean readable silhouettes, same wood/brass western harbor setting; no pixel art, no 3D game render, no ornate fantasy palace.
UI: on RIGHT third over calm blue shadowed sea and muted sky, large warm ivory Chinese title "致未归的客人", smaller spaced serif English subtitle "GUESTS YET TO RETURN"; beneath, simple vertical ivory menu "开始游戏", "设置", "制作名单", "退出游戏". Thin gold underline only on first entry. Subtle legibility darkening behind menu integrated into sea, no opaque menu box, no parchment scroll, no modern icons. Single screenshot, not a collage, no frame or extra headings. Emphasize the empty chair and luminous peaceful sea; sunset light glances across the floorboards and chair.

Use case: ui-mockup.
A single 16:9 title-screen concept for painterly 2D story game "致未归的客人". Version C, the tide keeps a light: an airy poetic panoramic view of an island inlet at sunset, low horizon, huge quiet dusty rose/apricot/lilac sky, broad softly luminous sea in pale turquoise blending into evening blue, distant headland and small island on the LEFT with tiny warm-window timber tavern and small simple stone beacon, curving beach and a weathered landing stage from bottom left. Broad gentle curved tidal ripples and warm broken sunset reflection, an almost invisible lone boat far away. Composition deliberately simpler, cleaner and more spacious than a highly detailed harbor illustration, still exquisitely painted, soft gouache brush edges, tactile natural surfaces, refined hand-drawn illustration, not pixel art, not photorealism, not 3D. Evening beautiful, calming, a little nostalgic, no storm, no ominous fog, no strong black shadows.
UI centered in the spacious upper-middle sky: elegant large Chinese title "致未归的客人" in deep muted blue-brown with very subtle warm edge light, directly below small spaced serif English "GUESTS YET TO RETURN". Below it generous breathing room and a simple vertical menu centered around horizon/sea, "开始游戏", "设置", "制作名单", "退出游戏". Legible deep navy type with faint ivory soft halo; first entry a thin warm brass underline. No scroll panels, no card borders, no decorative clutter, no characters. One full screen, no concept board, no version label, no watermark. Beautiful sunset, delicate colored clouds, tiny tavern lamp is the emotional focal point.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent hand-painted cocktail catalogue icon, new sibling version called 回响 / Echo World.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target, existing Last Word cocktail icon.
Change ONLY the yellow-green liquid inside this coupe glass into beautiful bright translucent ocean blue: luminous pale azure and cyan upper highlights, slightly deeper cerulean body, soft watercolor variations, luminous but not emitting light. The drink should look like an elegant clear blue cocktail, not milk, not solid paint, not opaque jelly. Preserve exactly the original coupe silhouette, stem, base, scale, orientation, central composition, rim, hand-drawn pen outlines, transparent glass, cream-white sunset reflections and painterly paper brush texture. The GLASS remains colorless, not blue tinted. Preserve the liquid fill level. Keep existing negative space transparent, genuinely alpha background. No background scene, no text or label, no new garnish, no ice cubes, no glitter or neon glow. Do not redesign or simplify the cup.
